newsitem.title: USA: IntegraMed America Inc Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: IntegraMed America Inc Q3 loss.

text.p: (all amounts in thousands, except per share amounts)
For the Three Months For the Nine Months
Weighted average number of shares of common

(1) The 1996 dividends accrued on preferred stock and weighted average number of shares of common stock outstanding give effect to the conversion of 608,234 shares of preferred stock into 2,432,936 shares of common stock.(2) Since IntegraMed America issued an additional 1,550,997 common shares in the conversion offer, the company was required, pursuant to a recently enacted accounting pronouncement, to deduct the fair value of these additional shares of approximately $4,265,000 from earnings available to common shareholders.
